name: smartcart-root
description: SmartCart project ROOT. The React app is NOT here - it is in the innermost smartcart/smartcart/smartcart folder. This file exists only to print a helpful message when npm is run in the wrong place.

scripts.wrong-folder: node -e "console.log('');console.log('  WRONG FOLDER');console.log('  ------------');console.log('  You are in:  smartcart\\  (project root)');console.log('  This folder has NO React app and NO package.json scripts to run.');console.log('');console.log('  The React app is in the INNERMOST folder. Run these two lines:');console.log('');console.log('     cd smartcart\\smartcart\\smartcart');console.log('     npm run dev');console.log('');console.log('  Tip: run \"dir\" after cd. If you do not see vite.config.js, you are one level too high.');console.log('');process.exit(1);"
